# sam-js (vendored)

`samjs.esm.min.js` is sam-js 0.3.1 by Christian Schiffler (github.com/discordier/sam),
a JavaScript port of a reverse-engineered C version of **S.A.M. (Software Automatic
Mouth)**, the 1982 speech synthesizer by Don't Ask Software, later SoftVoice, Inc.

It has **no open-source licence**. In the author's words, the original is abandonware
whose copyright holder (SoftVoice, Inc.) could not be reached, so the port "cannot be
put under any specific open source software license. Use it at your own risk."

It is included here at the project owner's request, with that risk accepted. Lowtide
uses it only to voice spoken lines (`game/voice.js`). To remove it, delete this folder
and `game/voice.js`; the game falls back to subtitles alone.
